A calmer way to run people operations.

Who builds OrgVia and what we are trying to get right.

Where OrgVia comes from

OrgVia began as Hunar Attendance, a location-verified attendance product, and has grown into a multi-tenant HRMS with an organization workspace for HR and a separate console for platform administration.

It is a young product. We would rather show you what works today and be clear about what is still being built than overpromise.

What we hold to

  • Clarity. Screens that explain themselves.
  • Precision. Records people can rely on.
  • People first. HR software serves the people in the company, not only the process.
  • Honesty. We describe the product as it is.

Separation by design

Organization data is tenant-scoped and platform administration is a separate system.

Server-side access

Role and reporting-line rules are enforced by the backend, not just by the interface.

Built in the open with you

We want early customers to shape the roadmap. Tell us what you need.
